hero.title: Who we are.
hero.lead: The institutional foundation of Possibilities Africa — vision, approach, leadership, and how to reach us.

whoWeAre.title: A ministry walking with local churches.
whoWeAre.lead: Possibilities Africa exists so rural communities grow in faith, family life, and daily wellbeing — led by pastors already present in the village.
points: We work as one ministry with churches, partners, and communities across seven countries.
Local churches lead; PA walks beside them for about two years of training and practice.
Stories and simple results sit side by side so the work stays clear and accountable.

visionMission.title: Whole gospel. Whole person. Whole community.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: With God all things are possible — rural Africa flourishing through pastor-led transformation.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: The whole gospel transforming the whole person and whole community — faith, families, livelihoods, youth, and responsible citizenship growing together.

approach.title: How the work is carried.
approach.lead: Pastor-led change, community ownership, and a clear two-year journey — not projects dropped in from outside.

items.title: Whole-gospel discipleship
items.text: Pastors are equipped so spiritual life and daily life grow together — not as separate tracks.

items.title: Pastor-led change
items.text: Local pastors carry the vision. Possibilities Africa walks with them through training and practice.

items.title: Community ownership
items.text: Water, farming, health, and livelihoods are planned and owned by the church and community.

items.title: Shalom groups
items.text: Groups of 30–50 leaders in each community deepen discipleship, cohesion, and local initiative.

items.title: A clear two-year journey
items.text: Every community moves through awareness, engagement, training, implementation, and multiplication.

leadership.title: People who steward the ministry.
leadership.lead: Board and team profiles will appear here. For now, the field work is led by pastor networks across seven countries.

history.title: From Webuye to seven countries.
history.lead: Possibilities Africa began in Webuye, Kenya, in 2005. The same pastor-led model now reaches communities across East and Southern Africa.

milestones.text: Networks grow in Malawi, Ethiopia, and Zambia
Newer footprints in Rwanda, Tanzania, and Burundi
